_readme: Resources shown on /resources/ (brief §2: approved guides, articles and free tools, with clear download or external-link labels). Articles come from insights.json automatically; list only guides and tools here. ACCESS: 'signup' (free, request with name + email; goes to its landing page) | 'download' (direct file, no sign-up) | 'external' (another site; opens in a new tab and says so). 'approval' follows the brief §7 content register. The Netlify tools named in brief §7 are NOT listed until Faith confirms ownership and data handling (see docs/02).
